full_prompt_en: A square halftone-print image crops tightly into one human eye and the side of a nose, using overlapping blue, yellow, red, and cream dot fields. The eye sits just above the center, looking outward beneath a dense dark-blue brow. Fine wrinkles and skin folds radiate from its lower corner as clusters of blue marks that shift from solid ink to separate dots. A broad yellow plane crosses the left cheek and temple, while the upper right burns with a rough red field. At the far right, the nose enters as a bright cream curve carrying dense black-blue dots along its shadowed side. Much of the left margin remains warm off-white, interrupted by scattered registration marks and a few faint red and yellow flecks. The blue ink around the eye is so dense it almost becomes continuous tone, but its printed dot structure stays legible. Yellow and red screens overlap the blue in places, producing irregular greenish and dark mixtures without smooth blending. The crop cuts away the rest of the face, making the eye, brow, and nose fragments nearly abstract shapes. Surface wear and imperfect alignment give the printed color a slightly broken, tactile edge. The viewer is placed extremely close, so the dot matrix is as noticeable as the facial form. Light is indicated by the unprinted cream areas around the eye and nose, while densely inked blue areas form shadow; no physical lamp or cast shadow is shown. No readable words appear. The overall composition is assertive and graphic, balancing the sharply focused gaze with exposed print mechanics and large blocks of primary-like color.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形网点印刷图像紧紧裁切一只人的眼睛和鼻子一侧，以重叠的蓝、黄、红和奶油色网点构成。眼睛位于中央略上，在密集深蓝眉下向外望。眼角下方的细皱纹与皮肤褶线由成簇蓝色笔点放射而出，从实墨逐渐分散为单独网点。一片宽阔黄色平面横过左脸颊和太阳穴，右上方则燃着粗糙红色域。最右边鼻子以明亮奶油色曲线进入，背光侧密布黑蓝点纹。左边缘大部分保留暖灰白色，只有零散套印痕和几处淡红、淡黄碎点打断。眼周蓝墨密到几乎成为连续调子，但印刷网点结构仍可辨。黄、红网层在某些地方盖过蓝色，形成不规则的偏绿和深色混合，却不作平滑晕染。裁切去掉脸的其余部分，使眼、眉和鼻的碎片几乎成为抽象形状。表面磨损与套色不齐令印刷色彩边缘略破碎、可触。观看者距画面极近，因此点阵和面部形体一样醒目。光由眼鼻附近未印墨的奶油色区域表现，密集蓝墨形成阴影；画内没有真实灯具或投影。没有可读词语。整体构图鲜明而图形化，以锐利目光平衡裸露的印刷机制和大片近原色。
style_prompt_en: The image has an enlarged halftone-print surface where visible dot screens and imperfect color registration construct tonal form. Dense dots fuse into dark masses, then open into sparse speckle along lighter edges. Deep cyan-blue, sharp yellow, warm red, and cream occupy bold neighboring areas; overlaps create secondary dark or greenish passages without seamless gradients. Cropping is tight, making a small focal region and the printing structure equally prominent. Some edges are crisp screen boundaries, while others fray into broken dots and worn ink. Illumination is expressed through unprinted pale ground and changing dot density, with compact dark accents supplying depth. Broad blank areas counter saturated clusters and prevent the surface from becoming uniformly busy. The overall effect is raw, graphic, and immediate, with mechanical repetition made visibly tactile.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有放大的网点印刷表面，可见的点状网版与并不完美的套色构造明暗形体。密点融合为深色团块，沿较亮边缘逐渐散成稀疏点纹。深青蓝、明黄、暖红与奶油色占据大胆相邻区域；重叠处形成次级深色或偏绿色通道，却没有无缝渐层。裁切紧密，使小块焦点与印刷结构同样醒目。一些边缘是清楚的网版分界，另一些则散成断点与磨损油墨。光亮通过未印色的浅底及网点密度变化表达，紧凑深色强调提供纵深。宽阔留白对照饱和密集区域，使表面不会平均繁忙。整体效果原始、图形化而直接，机械重复被转化为可见的触觉。
theme_en: A cropped human eye and nose constructed from blue, yellow, and red halftone dots
theme_zh: 由蓝、黄、红网点组成的眼睛与鼻子特写
name: Halftone print
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
